2607.04972.title: Multi-Robot Open Adaptive Teaming Across Unseen Environments, Partners, and Scales
2607.04972.paper_summary: Deploying robot teams in the real world requires simultaneous adaptation to unseen environments, unknown partners, and varying team sizes, yet existing approaches often address these challenges in isolation under the closed-world assumption of fixed teammates. We formalize this as open adaptive multi-robot teaming and propose a hypergraphic-form game formulation that captures team-level cooperative relationships beyond pairwise interactions, providing a principled foundation for coordination structure inference when team composition changes dynamically within episodes. Unlike graph neural network architectures, this is a game-theoretic construct for modeling strategic interactions and payoff structures among agents. Building on this formulation, we develop the Hypergraphic Open-ended Learning Algorithm (HOLA), which progressively expands partner and environment diversity during training rather than optimizing for fixed configurations. Evaluated on cooperative pursuit with multi-drone and multi-quadruped platforms, HOLA outperforms all baselines across all three adaptability dimensions. Learned policies transfer directly to physical hardware without fine-tuning, with successful deployments on Crazyflie and Zsibot L1 platforms confirming robust real-world coordination in novel environments with unseen teammates.
2607.04972.paper_summary_zh: 在現實世界中部署機器人團隊需要同時適應未見的環境、未知的夥伴和不同的團隊規模，然而現有的方法往往在封閉世界的假設下，將這些挑戰孤立地處理。<lb/>我們將此正式化為開放自適應多機器人團隊，並提出一種超圖形式的遊戲模型，捕捉超越成對互動的團隊層級合作關係，為在劇集內團隊組成動態變化時的協調結構推斷提供原則性基礎。<lb/>與圖神經網絡架構不同，這是一種用於建模代理之間戰略互動和收益結構的博弈論構造。<lb/>基於這一模型，我們開發了超圖開放式學習算法（HOLA），該算法在訓練過程中逐步擴展夥伴和環境的多樣性，而不是針對固定配置進行優化。<lb/>在多無人機和多四足機平台的合作追逐中進行評估，HOLA在所有三個適應性維度上均超越了所有基準。<lb/>學習到的策略可以直接轉移到物理硬體上，而無需微調，成功部署在Crazyflie和Zsibot L1平台上，證實了在新環境中與未見夥伴的穩健現實世界協調。
